metadata.description: Agent skills for the lanka framework — one plugin per package.

plugins.name: lanka-core
plugins.description: lanka — Twelve subsystems, two peer dependencies, five extension points.

plugins.name: lanka-storage
plugins.description: @lankajs/storage — Three adapters behind one port, WebCrypto encryption, encrypted zustand persistence.

plugins.name: lanka-async
plugins.description: @lankajs/async — Which response may be trusted, and how many requests a burst actually sends.

plugins.name: lanka-host
plugins.description: @lankajs/host — The two places lanka meets Next, React Router, TanStack Start or Expo: one instance per unit of server work, and one first state per screen.

plugins.name: lanka-optimistic
plugins.description: @lankajs/optimistic — Two concurrency strategies with real request cancellation.

plugins.name: lanka-collection
plugins.description: @lankajs/collection — Sort, filter and paginate on the client without handing React a new array every time.

plugins.name: lanka-blob-cache
plugins.description: @lankajs/blob-cache — IndexedDB → Cache Storage → memory → direct fetch, with a memory budget and quota eviction.

plugins.name: lanka-browser
plugins.description: @lankajs/browser — Things with no single API and a fallback for older engines.

plugins.name: lanka-zod
plugins.description: @lankajs/zod — An explicit validator choice: typed helpers plus a bridge for zod 3.

plugins.name: lanka-valibot
plugins.description: @lankajs/valibot — The same explicit choice, a different library. Shaped identically to @lankajs/zod on purpose.

plugins.name: lanka-arktype
plugins.description: @lankajs/arktype — The same explicit choice, a third library. Nothing to adapt: arktype speaks Standard Schema.

plugins.name: lanka-yup
plugins.description: @lankajs/yup — The one package in the family a yup application cannot work without: a synchronous bridge.

plugins.name: lanka-typebox
plugins.description: @lankajs/typebox — A bridge for the one library in the family with no Standard Schema, and a compiled checker it caches.

plugins.name: lanka-effect
plugins.description: @lankajs/effect — Effect keeps its Standard Schema behind a wrapper function; this holds the wrapper still.

plugins.name: lanka-any-schema
plugins.description: @lankajs/any-schema — For the application that ended up with two schema libraries: one validator that routes by dialect.

plugins.name: lanka-http
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-http — Retry, idempotency, CSRF, credentials, auth refresh and timeout as request middleware.

plugins.name: lanka-sse
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-sse — SSE transport, bridges into scenarios, and a "came from outside" marker for mutations.

plugins.name: lanka-websocket
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-websocket — A WebSocket behind the same port SSE uses, plus the half SSE does not have: sending.

plugins.name: lanka-graphql
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-graphql — A request kind that reads the errors array, a gateway that writes query and mutate, and graphql-ws as a stream.

plugins.name: lanka-grpc
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-grpc — The framing, the trailers and the status codes — with the message codec left to whoever generated it.

plugins.name: lanka-prefetch
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-prefetch — SSE > request > route chunk > prefetch — a rule the code enforces.

plugins.name: lanka-bootstrap-steps
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-bootstrap-steps — A step receives context, returns it changed, may exit early and redirect.

plugins.name: lanka-devtools
plugins.description: @lankajs/plugin-devtools — The data is already collected and shown to nobody.

plugins.name: lanka-di
plugins.description: @lankajs/tool-di — The `@lanka_di` alias, scaffolding for six barrels, and a contract check before the build starts — for six bundlers, or for one with no adapter at all.

plugins.name: lanka-eslint
plugins.description: @lankajs/tool-eslint — The framework's main promise — imports go one way — is checked by the framework, not by its consumers.

plugins.name: lanka-testing
plugins.description: @lankajs/tool-testing — The only package allowed into core's internals, and therefore the one that justifies sealing them.

plugins.name: lanka-skills
plugins.description: @lankajs/tool-skills — Puts each installed package's agent skill into the project, at the version actually installed.
